I'll write the test first. The templates are in sync now, so it will pass on the real files. To watch it fail, I'll introduce drift temporarily and restore the file afterwards. This isn't a git repo, so I'll back the file up first.

<edit path="tests/test_issue_templates.py">
from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE"
TEMPLATES = ["bug.md", "feature.md", "question.md", "docs.md"]
BEGIN = "<!-- triage: begin -->"
END = "<!-- triage: end -->"


def triage_block(name):
    text = (TEMPLATE_DIR / name).read_text()
    start = text.find(BEGIN)
    assert start != -1, f"{name}: missing {BEGIN}"
    end = text.find(END, start)
    assert end != -1, f"{name}: missing {END}"
    return text[start : end + len(END)]


def test_triage_blocks_are_identical_across_templates():
    blocks = {name: triage_block(name) for name in TEMPLATES}
    reference = blocks["bug.md"]
    drifted = [name for name, block in blocks.items() if block != reference]
    assert not drifted, f"triage block differs from bug.md in: {drifted}"
</edit>

<command>cp .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md /tmp/feature.md.bak && sed -i '' 's/^\*\*Priority:\*\* p3$/**Priority:** p2/' .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md && uv run pytest tests/test_issue_templates.py -q</command>

Expected: a failure (not an error) with `triage block differs from bug.md in: ['feature.md']`. If it passes, the sed didn't match and I'd inspect the file before going on.

Restore the template and confirm it's byte-identical:

<command>cp /tmp/feature.md.bak .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md && diff /tmp/feature.md.bak .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md && echo restored</command>

Verify green, then run the documented suite:

<command>uv run pytest tests/test_issue_templates.py -q</command>

Message to my partner:

I added `tests/test_issue_templates.py`. It extracts the text between `<!-- triage: begin -->` and `<!-- triage: end -->` in `bug.md`, `feature.md`, `question.md` and `docs.md`, and fails if any block differs from `bug.md`'s. The failure message names the drifted files. It also fails with a clear message if a template is missing a marker.

Because the templates are in sync today, the test passed on the real files, so I watched it fail another way. I changed the Priority line in `feature.md` to p2, confirmed the failure named `feature.md`, then restored the file from a backup and checked it was byte-identical. Then I ran the new test (green) and the full `uv run pytest -q`. I'll report the results of those runs, including any failures that aren't from this change.

Two things to know:
- Any difference inside the block counts as drift, including trailing whitespace.
- `bug.md` is the reference. If you'd rather compare against a canonical file or constant, say so.
